BIRD: Raggiana Bird-of-paradise
RATIONALE: The Raggiana Bird-of-paradise is famed for its spectacular and diverse plumage, showcasing a vibrant array of reds, yellows, and greens. This stunning display of multiple colors perfectly embodies the card's ability to produce mana of any color, symbolizing its universal connection to all forms of natural energy. Its exotic beauty makes it a fitting emblem of a primordial source of mana.
